decisions.reason: Because this air fin cooler is close to the core offer and the firm has growth, investment and R&D slack, management is likely to keep it while learning about its market performance.
Although a new condenser variant could be pruned if results disappoint, its close fit with the established business and the firm's current expansion make retention more likely than withdrawal.
This condenser is also near the core portfolio, but overlap with similar products raises the chance of later rationalisation slightly, even though the firm's slack still favors keeping it for now.
The tube liner builds on the installed-base service business, which suits the firm's reliability and lifecycle-service strengths, so it is likely to be kept unless performance clearly falls short.
A customized industrial air cooler matches the firm's solution-oriented strategy and engineering capabilities, and in a growing market there is little pressure to drop it quickly.

These repair inserts strongly complement aftermarket services and resource-efficient upgrading, so under behavioral logic and with available slack they are the least likely products to be removed soon.
